title: Pinion at the inner rim
intent: Identify the engaged tooth boundary to infer the follower's spin.

choices.reason: The pinion and internal ring move together at their common tangent. Both turn clockwise.
Reversing the ring treats the contact as a pair of exterior gears.
The frame locates the ring axle. Its bearing allows rotation.
A tooth moves along the rim. The ring center stays on its fixed axle.
